title: Number of Telemedicine Service Providers and Take-up Rate for Their Services
what_it_is: Number of Telemedicine Service Providers and Take-up Rate for Their Services

sections.label: MOH telemedicine tracking and facilitation
sections.summary: MOH does not track telemedicine take-up or definitive data on reduced Emergency Department attendances, but facilitates telemedicine in primary and specialist care.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) does not track the take-up rate of telemedicine services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: There is also no definitive data on whether telemedicine has reduced non-emergency attendances at Emergency Departments, especially given an ageing population with rising demand for healthcare.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Telemedicine services have been facilitated by MOH in primary care for chronic disease management and in specialist outpatient settings for specific conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH will continue to facilitate the application of telemedicine service in appropriate settings.

sections.label: Removing barriers to telemedicine use
sections.summary: The speaker says obstacles should be removed where telemedicine is safe, efficacious, convenient and accessible, and work is ongoing on regulation and cost barriers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: And where it is a suitable option for the clinical providers because is safe, efficacious, it provides better quality of care; or for the patient because it is convenient and provides better access, then, we want to remove the obstacles for the clinician or the patient from choosing this.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we are working on standardising the regulatory approach across, as well as reducing some of the barriers in terms of cost and financials associated in terms of the choice that a patient might make.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, the short answer to both questions is that we would like to see progress for hospitals as well as primary care using telemedicine services appropriately, where it makes a difference to the clinical care, where it becomes more convenient and more acceptable to the patients.
